qualification.frozen_input_readback: All 657 recorded hashes matched after every case settled and before admission. A deliberately incorrect native executable hash was refused by the same reader. No observed result was replaced.

ordinary_execution.timing_scope: Canonical persisted phase timestamps identify dispatch and fresh verification spans. The residual includes setup, inference and completion; it is not a provider latency measurement.
ordinary_execution.preceding_smokes: Two ordinary widgets requests abstained and completed through fallback before the stock-items request committed. These are retained smoke observations, not additions to the qualification cohort.

ordinary_baseline.comparison_scope: The baseline requested widgets; the successful qualified smoke requested stock_items. These runs do not establish a matched latency or cost improvement.

controls.approval: The parked ask matched exactly one canonical learned-generation receipt and the admitted qualification digest. A one-use grant ran the mutation and passed all 34 independent checks.
controls.stop: The parked ask matched exactly one canonical learned-generation receipt. Cancellation ended as user_cancelled with an unchanged isolated workspace.
controls.steer: The parked ask matched exactly one canonical learned-generation receipt. Steer changed no files, completed the replacement objective, and rejected the late grant with code -32005.
controls.approval_policy: The normal auto run envelope was authorized, with a normal user permission rule asking before the exact learned mutator. No trial flag was used. The prompt-writes rung correctly refused the entire unattended authority envelope and supplied no inference evidence.
controls.measurement_negative_control: An earlier steer probe reached the same tool through ordinary fallback after binding declined. The receipt-correlating verifier refused to credit it as learned execution. Earlier probes that abstained before reaching any ask also remain uncredited.

interpretation: The unchanged candidate passed a fresh prospective study on the published runtime. Its raw selector still chose 11 incompatible requests; later binding and preflight gates prevented all incompatible commitments. Qualification concerns the combined dispatch contract, not the raw selector alone. Unknown ancillary costs remain null and reserved under the prospectively declared policy. The earlier strict-accounting V4 report remains refused.
limits: Related synthetic templates, one small application, one reviewed generator, and one observation per qualification case. No IID deployment sample or production reliability guarantee. Fallback completion does not independently grade fallback output. Qualification binds measured execution identity; this report does not qualify unrelated later runtime changes.
